options.content:
**All-traffic aggregates** count inference arrivals, refused admission, degraded admission and terminal outcomes at the limiter. Project / Agent Runtime / key filters apply **only to Core-reserved reporting** below. Shared keys cannot identify an individual caller. Model filters apply to panels marked “model”; arrivals, refusals, active and health remain all-model totals.

**Request detail and attributed usage: last 7 days only.** Low-cardinality Prometheus aggregates: up to 15 days, subject to 20 GB storage. Unknown tokens/timings are unavailable, not zero. Final usage and completion measurements appear after termination. Timings are limiter-observed, not client receipt or engine decode speed. Core accounting remains the Runaway Guard authority. Historical data is available only after collection began.

panels.title: Observed input / output tokens per second · model
panels.description: Reported upstream totals only. Missing/estimated usage does not contribute invented tokens. Cached/reasoning subcounts are not added to totals.

panels.title: Reported input / output tokens in range · model
panels.description: Counter extrapolation over the selected range; unknown responses excluded. Diagnostic token sums below use retained completed events.

panels.title: First meaningful output delay · model
panels.description: Streams only, measured from limiter acceptance. Headers, roles, metadata and keepalives do not count. Reasoning and tool payload count as first output; only answer text counts as first answer.

panels.title: First answer-text delay · model
panels.description: Streams only, measured from limiter acceptance. Headers, roles, metadata and keepalives do not count. Reasoning and tool payload count as first output; only answer text counts as first answer.

panels.title: Request / stream duration · model
panels.description: Limiter acceptance through upstream completion/error or client cancellation. Frozen before accounting retries. Nonstreaming exposes duration only.

panels.title: Usage settlement quality · all traffic
panels.description: Estimate means upstream actual token totals unavailable. Diagnostic persistence is best-effort and bounded; failures never block inference.

options.content: The following panels apply Model, Project, Agent Runtime and Key filters to **trusted Core associations**. Filters are regular expressions over opaque IDs; `.*` includes all and `shared-unattributed` includes shared/unattributed associations. No Project or key appears in Prometheus labels. Usage here covers retained diagnostic events only; missing diagnostics and refused/degraded requests are excluded. Narrow the time range if queries reach Loki limits.

panels.title: Input tokens by Project · retained events
panels.description: Exact sums of known reported totals within retained events. Missing values excluded, not converted to zero. Immutable reservation IDs deduplicate ambiguous exporter retries before totals are grouped.

targets.expr: sum by (project) (max_over_time({service="finite-private-request-diagnostics"} | json reservation="reservationId", observed="observedAtUnixSeconds", model="model", endpoint="endpoint", project="projectId", runtime="agentRuntimeId", key="apiKeyId", value="promptTokens" | label_format diagnostic_age="{{sub (unixEpoch now) .observed}}" | diagnostic_age >= 0 | diagnostic_age <= 604800 | drop diagnostic_age | model=~"$model" | endpoint=~"$endpoint" | project=~"${project:raw}" | runtime=~"${runtime:raw}" | key=~"${key:raw}" | value!="" | unwrap value | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Request details · Core-reserved only · last 7 days

options.content: The metadata table shows at most **1,000 newest matching records**, with table pagination. Narrow the time range / filters to inspect more; the operator Core endpoint also provides a stable timestamp+reservation cursor for complete traversal. Refused/degraded arrivals have no rows. Null means unavailable. **Per-request decode speed is unavailable:** upstream final token counts and SSE chunk boundaries do not establish exact engine generation bounds. Use observed output tokens per wall-clock second above. Requested aliases resolve to the recorded routed model; served-model identity is unavailable when upstream does not establish it.

panels.title: Request metadata · newest 1,000 matches; narrow range for more

targets.expr: {service="finite-private-request-diagnostics"} | json reservation="reservationId", observed="observedAtUnixSeconds", model="model", endpoint="endpoint", project="projectId", runtime="agentRuntimeId", key="apiKeyId" | label_format diagnostic_age="{{sub (unixEpoch now) .observed}}" | diagnostic_age >= 0 | diagnostic_age <= 604800 | drop diagnostic_age | model=~"$model" | endpoint=~"$endpoint" | project=~"${project:raw}" | runtime=~"${runtime:raw}" | key=~"${key:raw}"

panels.title: Current Runaway Guard state · all active grants

options.content: Latest successfully collected snapshot per grant; **Project/runtime/key/model filters do not apply** because guard limits belong to the grant. Burst usage includes reservations, with expired windows shown as zero and no active reset. Weekly usage is a rolling 7×24-hour accounting window when enabled; next expiry is the oldest included reservation aging out, not a calendar reset. Aging reservations are older than 15 minutes and are not a live-request count. This observer never settles or repairs them. Up to 1,000 active grants are collected; a zero guard-completeness indicator means a partial snapshot.

panels.title: Latest guard snapshots · last minute; stale rows disappear

targets.expr: {service="finite-private-guard-status"} | json observed="observedAtUnixSeconds" | label_format diagnostic_age="{{sub (unixEpoch now) .observed}}" | diagnostic_age >= 0 | diagnostic_age <= 60 | drop diagnostic_age

panels.title: Reporting health · current
panels.description: 0 or unavailable means reporting is incomplete. A missing exporter process becomes stale even if its previous run succeeded.

panels.title: Unexported backlog and oldest age
panels.description: -1 means the failed run could not establish backlog. Events are retried until retained expiry; monitoring never changes accounting.
